name: Exoplanet transit follow-up
question: Which known or candidate transiting-planet host stars should receive a transit observation in this window?

features.name: transit_window_proximity
features.rationale: A transit can only be observed while it happens; only a predicted mid-transit inside this window is a scientific opportunity tonight.

features.name: visibility
features.rationale: Below the altitude limit the observation is not feasible from the declared site.

features.name: instrument_suitability
features.rationale: Feasibility only: the target must be within the declared limiting magnitude. Brightness confers no relevance beyond feasibility.

features.name: observation_gap
features.rationale: Ephemeris refinement needs epochs spread in time; a recently observed host gains less.

features.name: evidence_quality
features.rationale: A precise ephemeris makes the predicted window trustworthy.

features.name: relationship_support
features.rationale: An endorsed host-companion relationship is what makes the star a transit target at all.
